entities.name: Yıldız Moran
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yıldız Moran was a Turkish photographer who was active from 1950 to 1962. Her work has posthumously been shown in solo exhibitions at Pera Museum and at İstanbul Modern in Istanbul, and is held in the collection of the latter.
